name: Strong Hire: gap analysis (GA-1)
description: Rate a CV against a job posting's requirements and competencies. Strong Hire turns the ratings into a 0-100 match score in code (with its evidence rule); gap_match_score is that score and gap_fit checks it against the pair's expected band: match (same job family, seniority within one level) 60-100, mismatch (unrelated family) 0-40. Adjacent families and big seniority gaps have no band; read their gap_match_score per fit slice. Prompts are Strong Hire's own (built by scripts/build_strong_hire.py); a model with prompt_tier small gets the small-model variant where the row has one.
